scope: Original W4A16 optimization only; failed startup attempts excluded from statistics.

protocol.scope: Real layer0 fused weights; same quantized matrix represented densely for FP16 reference. Hot microbench only, not full model speed or navigation quality.

failed_attempts.reason: Custom module registered only in parent; spawned worker loaded stock model, leaving timing/input receipts absent.
Engine field propagated to MiscConfig while worker reads ModelConfig; startup audit guard rejected missing adapter before requests.

resolution: Top-level registration re-executes under __mp_main__; CPU-only spawn selection and subsequent real execution receipts verified. Original installed package untouched.

fp16_idle_probe.caveat: Single FP16 process; cannot by itself diagnose cross-process kernel selection, cache or system-state changes.

fp16_idle_protocol.scope: One unchanged FP16 eager model process; alternating 0/1 second untimed idle. Diagnose run variability, not a new optimization.
fp16_idle_protocol.weight_identity_scope: Full SHA already verified by preceding confirmation controller; model modification time predates that receipt. No new weight write or full rehash.

fp16_idle_probe_scope: Separate 12-measurement same-process diagnostic. Does not explain the much larger cross-process FP16 CUDA-interval drift; do not pool with main comparisons.
